units.titles: Native tokens can be drained from the Factory contract | Bypassing maxTokensPerUser limits for ERC721 DAO
units.known_address_notes: Pashov review of StationX-Network/smartcontract (repo now private/404) - scope: Station Factory, Station/DAO creation, cross-chain (LayerZero) buys, ERC721 DAO maxTokensPerUser. StationX app bundle ships its per-chain config; Base entry = factoryContractAddress 0xeb6FE72d.., claimFactoryAddress 0x50702Fd9.., buyDaoToken 0x696eEE78..; the same bundle also lists Ethereum 0x3b0496Dd.., Arbitrum 0x7213172e.., Polygon 0x726D3e4f.., BSC 0x8a1D0Be1.., all returning 2,112-byte proxy code. Base was used

units.titles: Incorrect totalAssets Calculation Due to Claimed-but-Unremoved WithdrawKeys | MetaVault Improperly Handles Last Redeem Claim Shortfalls
units.known_address_notes: Logarithm Labs MetaVault (ERC-7540 async vault) audited by Hexens Jul-2025; the project ships as maxAPY. Its official deployed-addresses page lists MetaVault USD 0x7a63e8... plus Engine, EngineReader, EngineSignatures, AssetManager, Gateways on Base (a matching MetaVault ETH set is also listed). All checked on Base with non-empty code; MetaVault/Engine names confirmed via Etherscan V2. Same addresses have no code on Ethereum, confirming Base-only.

units.titles: Missing Status Check Allows Repeated Payouts in releaseEscrow
units.known_address_notes: Hacken page identifies Cueva as PaydeceEscrow, repo PayDece/paydece-contracts, platforms BNB Chain/Polygon/Base. Repo only ships .openzeppelin/rinkeby.json (testnet) addresses. Verified PaydeceEscrow deployments were located by Blockscout Ethereum name search (0xd4a5, 0x540f, 0x6795, 0x1Bfc, 0xa4F4, 0x2790, 0xF49D); 0xd4a5 chosen as the verified anchor. BSC/Polygon/Base instances not pinned because those explorers are Cloudflare-gated.
